entries.head: shell out

senses.en: to pay a lot of money, often unwillingly

example.en: I had to shell out 800 yuan for a new phone screen.
example.zh: 换个手机屏我不得不掏了八百块。

entries.l1_note: 不情愿掏大钱；shell out for 后面接东西。

entries.head: rip off

senses.en: to charge someone too much money

example.en: That taxi driver ripped me off — the meter was rigged.
example.zh: 那个出租车司机宰了我，计价器被动过。

entries.l1_note: “被坑”是 I got ripped off，不是 I was cheated money。

entries.head: throw in

senses.en: to add something extra to a deal for free

example.en: The seller threw in a phone case and a charger.
example.zh: 卖家额外送了手机壳和充电器。

entries.l1_note: 附赠；throw in 也有“插一句”的意思。

entries.head: save up

senses.en: to keep money until you have enough for something

example.en: I'm saving up for a trip to Japan next spring.
example.zh: 我在攒钱，明年春天去日本。

entries.l1_note: “攒钱”是 save up (for)，不是 save money up 的顺序问题；save money 是省钱。

entries.head: cut back

example.en: We cut back after the rent went up.
example.zh: 房租涨了之后我们开始省着花。

entries.l1_note: 削减开支；cut back on 后面接具体项。

entries.head: settle up

senses.zh: 把这顿饭或这趟账结掉
senses.en: to pay what you owe, often at the end of a meal or trip

example.en: Let's settle up before we leave — I'll send you the split.
example.zh: 走之前把账结了吧，我把分摊金额发你。

entries.l1_note: 结清账；settle 是解决、安顿。

entries.head: chip in

senses.en: when several people each pay part of a cost

example.en: We all chipped in for a gift for the boss.
example.zh: 我们凑钱给老板买了个礼物。

entries.l1_note: “AA”不是 AA in English；各付各的是 split the bill，一起凑钱是 chip in。

entries.head: fork over

example.en: He forked over 200 yuan for parking.
example.zh: 他停车不情愿地掏了两百块。

entries.l1_note: 不情愿交钱，比 shell out 更口语。

entries.head: pay back

example.en: I'll pay you back as soon as I get my salary.

entries.l1_note: “还钱”不是 return money 才自然；pay someone back 更常用。代词夹中间：pay me back。

entries.head: put down
entries.zh: 先付一笔定金；放下；贬低

senses.en: to pay part of the price now and the rest later

example.en: We put down a deposit on the apartment yesterday.
example.zh: 我们昨天给公寓交了定金。

senses.en: to put something on a surface

example.en: Put down the box before you hurt your back.
example.zh: 先把箱子放下，别闪了腰。

senses.en: to criticize someone and make them feel small

example.en: Stop putting down your coworkers in meetings.

entries.l1_note: 付定金；put down 也指贬低、放下。

entries.head: shop around

senses.en: to compare prices in several places

example.en: Shop around before you buy — the same laptop is 800 cheaper online.
example.zh: 买之前多比比，同款笔记本网上便宜八百。

entries.l1_note: 货比三家是 shop around，不是 compare shops（中式）。

entries.head: pay up

senses.en: to pay money you owe, often unwillingly

example.en: He finally paid up after three reminders.
example.zh: 催了三次他才把钱付了。

entries.l1_note: pay up 带“被催着”的意味；pay 是中性。

entries.head: cough up

example.en: The landlord finally coughed up for the broken heater.
example.zh: 房东最后才掏钱修暖气。

entries.l1_note: cough up 很口语，等于“挤出钱来”。

entries.head: total up

senses.en: to add everything to get a final amount

example.en: Total up the receipt before you split it.
example.zh: 分摊前先把小票合计一下。

entries.l1_note: 合计是 total up / add up，不是 count together（中式）。

entries.head: add up

example.en: The small purchases add up faster than you think.
example.zh: 小钱加起来比你想象的快。

entries.l1_note: add up 是加起来；说得通也是 add up。

entries.head: mark down

senses.en: to lower the price of something

example.en: They marked down the winter coats after New Year.
example.zh: 过完年他们把冬装降价了。

entries.l1_note: 降价是 mark down；mark up 是涨价。

entries.head: mark up

example.en: Some sellers mark up the price before a sale.
example.zh: 有些卖家促销前先把价提上去。

entries.l1_note: mark up 是提价；名词 markup 是加价幅度。

entries.head: knock off

example.en: Can you knock off twenty if I take two?
example.zh: 我买两个能便宜二十吗？

entries.l1_note: knock off 也指收工、仿冒品（knockoff），看语境。

entries.head: sell off

senses.en: to sell goods cheaply to get rid of them

example.en: The store is selling off last season's stock.

entries.l1_note: 清仓是 sell off；卖光是 sell out，出卖也是 sell out。

entries.head: stock up

senses.en: to buy a lot of something for later

example.en: Stock up on noodles before the vacation.

entries.l1_note: 囤货是 stock up (on)，不是 store up（也可但少）。

entries.head: take back

example.en: Can I take back this shirt without the receipt?
example.zh: 这件衬衫没小票能退吗？

entries.l1_note: 退货是 take back；退款是 get a refund。

entries.head: send back

example.en: I sent back the wrong size and they refunded me.
example.zh: 我把尺码不对的寄回去了，他们退了款。

entries.l1_note: 寄回是 send back；send off 是寄出。

entries.head: bring back

example.en: Bring back a receipt in case it doesn't fit.
example.zh: 把小票带回来，万一不合身。

entries.l1_note: 带回是 bring back；带回记忆也是 bring back。

entries.head: try out

senses.zh: 试一段时间看合不合适

example.en: You can try out the app for a week for free.
example.zh: 这个 App 可以免费试用一周。

entries.l1_note: 试用是 try out；试穿是 try on，别混。

entries.head: put aside

example.en: She puts aside 500 a month for travel.
example.zh: 她每月存五百块旅行基金。

entries.l1_note: 存钱是 put aside / set aside；save up 是攒够某数。

entries.head: go for

example.en: I went for the cheaper model and regret it a bit.
example.zh: 我选了便宜那款，有点后悔。

entries.l1_note: 选是 go for；不是 choose for（中式）。

entries.head: settle on

example.en: We settled on the blue sofa after two weeks.
example.zh: 比较两周后我们定了蓝色沙发。

entries.l1_note: 决定选是 settle on；settle for 是退而求其次。

entries.head: shop for

senses.en: to look for particular things to buy

example.en: I'm shopping for a gift for my mom.

entries.l1_note: 选购是 shop for；买东西是 go shopping。

entries.head: snap up

senses.en: to buy something quickly because it is a good deal

example.en: The tickets were snapped up in ten minutes.

entries.l1_note: 抢购是 snap up，不是 rob buying（中式）。

entries.head: share out

example.en: Let's share out the bill evenly.

entries.l1_note: 分摊是 share out；split the bill 更口语。

entries.head: give away

senses.en: to give something to someone for free

example.en: I gave away my old desk on the neighborhood app.
example.zh: 我把旧书桌在小区群里送人了。

senses.en: to reveal a secret without meaning to

example.en: His smile gave away the surprise.
example.zh: 他的笑把惊喜泄露出去了。

entries.l1_note: 代词夹中间：give it away；give away it 不自然。

entries.head: tell apart

senses.en: to see the difference between two things

example.en: These two phone cases are so similar I can't tell them apart.
example.zh: 这两个手机壳太像了，我分不出来。

entries.l1_note: tell A and B apart 或 tell them apart；代词夹中间。

entries.head: add on

example.en: You can add on a warranty at checkout.

entries.l1_note: add on 是附加/加购；add up 是加起来。

entries.head: bargain for

example.en: I didn't bargain for such a long return line.
example.zh: 我没想到退货队会这么长。

entries.l1_note: bargain for 常出现在否定句：didn't bargain for。

entries.head: part with

example.en: I hate to part with this old bike.
example.zh: 我真舍不得这辆旧自行车。

entries.l1_note: part with + 东西；不是“分开”。

entries.head: bring out

example.en: The brand brought out a cheaper model this spring.
example.zh: 这个品牌今年春天推出了一款更便宜的型号。

entries.l1_note: bring out + 产品；不是“带出来”。

entries.head: give back

example.en: Give back the borrowed charger tomorrow.
example.zh: 明天把借的充电器还回去。

entries.l1_note: give back + 东西；代词夹中间。

entries.head: lose out on

example.en: We lost out on the discount by one day.
example.zh: 我们晚了一天，错过了折扣。

entries.l1_note: lose out on + 机会/好处；不是“输出去”。

entries.head: pass off

example.en: He tried to pass off the fake bag as real.

entries.l1_note: pass off A as B 是冒充；不是“传过去”。

entries.head: swear by

example.en: My mom swears by this brand of shoes.
example.zh: 我妈特别认这个牌子的鞋。

entries.l1_note: swear by + 东西；不是“对着发誓”。
